summary: Staged migration adds marketing_opt_in column with DEFAULT FALSE, backfills existing rows using a repeat-until-complete UPDATE with IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE, deploys new version with state_only migration, retires old version, and contracts column to NOT NULL, ensuring zero-downtime and consistency across both app versions.
write_consistency: Old version INSERTs/UPDATEs omit the new column, receiving DB DEFAULT FALSE; new version explicitly sets marketing_opt_in; backfill updates all existing rows to False before deploy_new; after deploy_new, all rows (including old-version inserts) have False, satisfying the no-NULL check. The column is later set NOT NULL after old version retires.
revision_notes: Plan for adding marketing_opt_in boolean column to account_user with zero-downtime rollout.

stages.description: Add nullable marketing_opt_in column with DEFAULT FALSE so old version inserts default to False.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;

stages.description: Backfill marketing_opt_in to False for all rows where it is not already False, using a condition that becomes false after update.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = FALSE WHERE marketing_opt_in IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE;

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version; new version continues serving traffic.
Set marketing_opt_in to NOT NULL; all rows already have False, so constraint succeeds.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL;
